data.key: Domain Power ~ It Came from Beyond
data.name: It Came from Beyond
data.description: Once per day, when you cast a summoning spell, any one creature you summon is more powerful than normal. The creature gains the advanced creature simple template. If you summon more than one creature with a spell, only one of the summoned creatures gains the advanced creature simple template. A summoned creature that gains the advanced creature simple template in this manner appears unnervingly deformed or unnaturally hideous, bringing with it a whiff of the emptiness of the void. This ability works only on spells you cast as a cleric-it does not work on spellcasting abilities gained from any other spellcasting classes you might have.
